cpu_mode: one Scene.FixedUpdate plus Scene.Update, includes LateUpdate readback/normals/tubes, no GPU device
render_mode: one fixed tick plus one Update and rendered frame per sample, uncapped; one physics tick per rendered frame intentionally stresses high FPS
repeats: 1 for CPU exploration,3 for rendered confirmation and sensitivity/resting; initial CPU sweep3
benchmark_profile_recordings: separate runs, excluded from capacity timings
desktop_load: normal desktop; sequential unpinned runs, uncontrolled clocks/thermals
sampling_strategy: Initial sweeps: 3 processes,120 warmup,240 samples. Remaining exploratory CPU sweeps:1 process,60 warmup,120 samples. Rendered confirmation:3 processes,60 warmup,180 samples. Settings for each process are exact in manifest args.
